grh_5146179ede84e172f3e0.title: April Fools Day Adventure
paragraphs: Soon after Holmes and Watson begin sharing Baker Street, Lady Anne and friends stage an April Fool trick by planting clues at her safe that appear to identify Holmes himself as an emerald thief. The joke turns real when the genuine stone vanishes from its secret hiding place and one participant, calling himself Murphy, produces only an excellent paste copy. Holmes realizes such a copy could not have been made since the previous night and discovers that Murphy separately told Stafford and Lady Anne that the prank was the other's idea. He had designed the joke in advance as cover for the real theft. Cornered, the criminal admits defeat and finally gives his true name: Moriarty, beginning the rivalry that will dominate Holmes's career.

[[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce. Other credited names include Edna Best as producer, Denis Green as writer, Anthony Boucher as writer, and Harry Bartell as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 29 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.bbd501bf461d302b|Petri Wines]] and [[org|org.bbd501bf461d302b|Petri Wines]].
This version is based on [[work|work.3d6758ba845daba1|A Study in Scarlet]]. Arthur Conan Doyle is credited as author.

grh_51fc553212b4498af4c0.title: An Honest Man
paragraphs: New York cabdriver Lou Marino finds a briefcase containing $200,000 left by two passengers just as his son Bobby is hospitalized for serious intestinal surgery and the family is struggling financially. Although the money could solve nearly every problem they face, Lou refuses to spend it and insists on finding its owners himself. He eventually traces the men and returns the full amount, becoming a reluctant public hero. The promised reward turns out to be only $200, and the attention makes it harder for Lou to work, but ordinary people moved by his honesty begin mailing the family money. Because many of the gifts have no return addresses, Lou finally cannot send them all back, leaving his stubborn honesty rewarded by strangers rather than by the wealthy owners of the briefcase.

grh_51df8d6fd5d473f81565.title: Psychological Murder
paragraphs: Rocky is drawn into the wealthy Bigelow household after Jane Bigelow becomes convinced she is going insane and will eventually murder her husband.
